architecture.responsibility: MATLAB-independent constant-stratification numerical kernel and FFT-engine interface
Forcing, field evaluation, fixed/adaptive integration, and composite state evolution
Observer descriptors, output planning, field sampling, and delivery orchestration
MATLAB-compatible checkpoint and model-output NetCDF schema, reading, and transactional writing
Compose checkpoint input, provider selection, integration, output, and diagnostics

findings.summary: Single-target and series checkpoint sinks duplicated shape validation, coefficient staging, time assignment, and capacity accounting.
findings.resolution: Use one private staging helper and one capacity helper without changing the public sink contracts or copy count.

findings.summary: The WaveVortex::Checkpoint alias named the complete portable runtime library as though it contained only persistence.
findings.resolution: Use the existing WaveVortex::PortableRuntime target consistently.

findings.summary: Canonical coefficient-only and composite-state integrator, dense-output, and output-driver families are deliberately parallel.
findings.rationale: Both are stable and independently tested; converging them before initial integration would change public boundaries and risk numerical and persistence behavior.

findings.summary: Checkpoint and model-output persistence share WVCheckpoint records and WVCheckpointStatus.
findings.rationale: Both encode the same wave-vortex-4x-v1 state and forcing profile; sharing avoids a second conversion and error hierarchy.

findings.summary: Model-output NetCDF implementation remains large after its schema, reader, and writer split.
findings.rationale: Responsibilities and built-in dispatch are now separated; file length alone does not justify another abstraction or visitor hierarchy.

findings.summary: portable-observers-v1 has a closed five-observer registry and rejects custom MATLAB subclasses.
findings.rationale: The flat versioned portable contract intentionally has no plug-in ABI; WVObserverAdapter centralizes all built-in identity and dispatch.

findings.summary: The initial standalone CLI integrates canonical coefficients and does not expose observer-graph configuration.
findings.rationale: This is an explicit v1 product limitation, not duplicated implementation; issue 222 may migrate the runner boundary without adding new CLI syntax.

findings.summary: CompiledKernel and PortableRuntime remain source directories in WaveVortexModel.
findings.rationale: There is one consumer and one release cadence; extraction is deferred until independent consumers or API versioning require it.
